question: If 7th May 2000 is Sunday, then what will be the day of the week on 15th July 2010?
solution:
Given : 7th May 2000 was Sunday

Explanation :

The number of odd days from 7th May 2000 to 15th July 2010 :

 
 

 Year
 Period
 Calculation
 Odd days
 
 

 2000
 7th May 2000 - 31 December 200
 365 days - 31 January - 28 February - 31 March - 30 April - 7 May = 242 days
 238 ÷ 7 = 0
 
 

 2001 - 2009
 Full year (7 Ordinary years + 2 Leap years)
 (1 × 7) + (2 × 2) = 11
 11 ÷ 7 = 4
 
 

 2010
 1st January 2014 - 15th July 2010
 31 January + 28 February + 31 March + 30 April + 31 May + 30 June + 15 July = 196 days
 350 ÷ 7 = 0
 
 

 Total odd days
 **4**
 
 

∴ The number of odd days from 7th May 2000 to 15th July 2010 ⇒ 4

⇒So, Four odd day get added to Monday because day asked in future.

∴ Thursday was the day of the week on the 15th July 2010.

Hence, "**Thursday**" is the correct answer.
